summary: Lane reports cover their closed declared evidence obligations and retain reported or legacy_unavailable origin. Optional oracle receipts share the evidence array and join controls, cases, pinned recipes, host-derived subjects, and retained execution authority without certifying semantic truth or full output logs. Finding resolutions use durably bound evidence or qualifying current-subject receipts; independently_executed controls require independent bound evidence. The dispatch pins schema and identity, and the adapter strips identity echoes. Worker.completed v6 preserves source-version boundaries; worker.failed remains v2. Workers gain no workflow verdict or completion authority.
title: A lane report discharges its lane's evidence obligations
